title: Soil chemistry survey of upland grassland plots, Peak District, 2024
description: Topsoil and subsoil samples from 40 upland grassland plots across three land-use classes in the Peak District National Park. Each sample was analysed for pH, organic carbon, total nitrogen and bulk density. Sampling followed a stratified random design; horizons were identified in the field. Collected as part of an undergraduate field course and deposited without further curation.
